issues.title: Generatorwise retraction needs multiplicativity
issues.quote: Suppose there is a retraction $\pi:G\to H$
issues.analysis: A set retraction does not map a word endpoint to the product of projected generators. The same issue recurs in inheritance and block templates. Root independently checked G=Z,H=2Z counterexample.
issues.suggested_fix: Require a homomorphic retraction and compatible ambient embeddings.

issues.title: Schreier action and intrinsic alphabet need matching conventions
issues.analysis: Left multiplication of prefixes is not a well-defined action on H-backslash-G for nonnormal H. Staying in H only implies ambient labels belong to H, not to an arbitrary restricted alphabet.
issues.suggested_fix: Use G/H and left action throughout; require S_H=S_G intersection H.

issues.title: Weighted formal Green series cannot admit arbitrary zero-cost cycles
issues.analysis: A free involution yields infinitely many words of fixed zero cost, and I-A0 need not be invertible. This differs from well-defined shortest-path costs.
issues.suggested_fix: Require strictly positive integer costs for the ordinary formal counting inverse and distinguish 0-1 shortest-path computations.

issues.title: Separate projections do not prove additive costs
issues.quote: the restricted metric has an exact projection onto both factors
issues.analysis: Separate one-Lipschitz factor projections supply only a max lower bound. Root counterexample uses C2 x C2 with all nonzero elements primitive.
issues.suggested_fix: Require aggregate generator cost bound and non-increasing restricted and ambient circuit embeddings.

issues.title: Reversible gate universality ignores parity beyond three bits
issues.quote: all three generate the full reversible group for $n\ge3$.
issues.analysis: At n>=4 NOT, CNOT, and Toffoli are each even permutations without ancillas, so cannot generate the symmetric group. Independent exact parity check on all 28 four-bit generators passed.
issues.suggested_fix: Restrict full symmetric generation to n=3 and state parity obstruction for n>=4.

issues.title: Nested scalar defects cannot change sign
issues.quote: Different $w$ can change the sign of the defect.
issues.analysis: For common nonnegative costs, ambient realizations contain restricted realizations, hence the difference of optimum costs is nonnegative.

issues.title: Referenced exploratory calculations are absent from archive
issues.quote: The accompanying atlas transcribes all twelve order-six main classes
issues.analysis: No four-bit sandwich verifier, affine distance artifact, or twelve-class Latin tables/verifier was present. This does not refute the reported experiments, but the current archive cannot certify them.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace packaged-computation promises by pending obligations; retain general spectral formula proof and contextual external citations.

issues.title: Four source programs missing from core reproduction package
issues.analysis: The reproduction driver referenced four absent Python programs. Parent retrieved the prior authoritative supplement.
issues.suggested_fix: Restore exact original bytes with hashes and rerun full supplement, which passed all 11 program checks.

issues.title: C++ witness feature overstated
issues.analysis: C++ exports distances and distribution, while only the Python implementation stores parent maps and reconstructs witnesses.
issues.suggested_fix: Identify Python witness reconstruction and C++ distributions explicitly.

issues.title: Four-gate case omitted from ambient lower-bound wording
issues.quote: Assume that a five-gate ambient word produces $C$.
issues.analysis: The conclusion excludes all lengths below six, so the four-gate case should be explicit. The same target-count and source arguments exclude it immediately.
issues.suggested_fix: Use at most five and include all-four-rows-once argument.

issues.title: Abstract model boundary conditions need explicit typing
issues.quote: with a common target class $\mathcal T$.
issues.analysis: The additive defect is undefined at infinity minus infinity; additive gate costs do not directly model depth; conjugation 2*l(g) assumes equal inverse cost; generic algebraic claims need clear field and finite-component hypotheses.
issues.suggested_fix: Restrict targets to finite ambient cost; use parallel layers for depth; state inverse symmetry and algebraically closed irreducible unit-cost setting.
